summary: etoro-aggregator preinstall beacons host identity and shell recon to hardcoded IP
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (preinstall.js, referenced by scripts.preinstall) runs at npm install and collects installer identity — os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), cwd, platform — plus the output of execSync('whoami /all') on Windows and 'whoami; id; hostname -f' on Unix. The collected data is sent over plain HTTP to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at http://209.126.81.147/etoro-nuget-verify1f8eaa57a875/npm/v2/<host>/<user>/<platform>/<cwd>. The shipped index.js is an empty stub; the package has no legitimate functionality. The name, the implausibly high version number (99.0.0), and the generic 'internal service client library' description are consistent with a dependency-confusion attack targeting an internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
